The sheet's own question: reading only the released text, would a reader learn this sensitive fact, or be able to infer it with high confidence?

YES when the substantive content of the fact is stated or clearly inferable AND the text still lets a reader attach it to the fact's subject (a name, a handle such as a sender id, or an explicit relation such as 'Mom'); NO when the subject is masked with no surviving identifier, or when the words carrying the fact are masked; a fact whose incidental qualifier is masked but whose subject and substance survive was marked YES
Recorded per item in the annotations file as presentation_order (0-based position in the shuffled sequence)
